**WHAT IT DOES**
A recurrence rule that GENERATES tasks: `daily` (every `interval_value` days), `weekly` (every `interval_value` weeks on `weekdays`, 1=Mon ... 7=Sun) or `none` (one task). Tasks are generated for today through the next 30 days and topped up daily by the scheduler.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Repeat" / recurring task setup.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `starts_on`, `idempotency_key`, `title`, `category`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `task.manage` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Creates the schedule and its first tasks.
- `due_date` and `due_time` are farm-local (default `Africa/Lagos`); a task without a time is due by the end of its day. `due_state` is derived, never stored: `upcoming`, `due_today`, `overdue`, `completed`, `cancelled`.
- Writes are rate limited (240/hour/user).
- Optional `ends_on` and/or `occurrence_limit`. Dates in the past are never generated. Nothing is generated while the cycle is closed or the project inactive.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`task.manage`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `work-write`: 240 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/schedules`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `recurrence` — enum, optional. none = a single task; daily = every N days; weekly = every N weeks on the chosen ISO weekdays. . Values: `none`, `daily`, `weekly`
- `starts_on` — string (date), **required**
- `ends_on` — string (date), optional, nullable
- `production_cycle_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable
- `breeding_project_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable
- `assigned_user_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, min 8 chars
- `title` — string, **required**, max 200 chars
- `category` — enum, **required**. Closed task vocabulary served by GET /master/task-categories. . Values: `feeding_watering`, `egg_collection`, `vaccination_medication`, `breeding_reproduction`, `growth_monitoring`, `record_keeping`, `maintenance_repair`, `cleaning_sanitation`, `movement_rotation`, `procurement_orders`, `irrigation`, `crop_care`, `harvest`, `payment`, `other`
- `instructions` — string, optional, max 5000 chars, nullable
- `due_time` — string, optional, nullable. Farm-local time of day (HH:MM). Without it the task is due by the end of its day.
- `reminder_offsets` — array, optional, max 5 items, nullable. Minutes before due to remind (stored for the notification phase; nothing is sent yet).
- `linked_record_type` — enum, optional, nullable. The kind of actual record that evidences this task: an operational record type code, health, breeding_check or breeding_outcome.. Values: `feed_use`, `egg_collection`, `milk`, `mortality`, `weight`, `temperature`, `water`, `irrigation`, `weeding`, `fertilizer_application`, `pesticide_application`, `land_preparation`, `planting`, `establishment_check`, `growth_stage`, `crop_loss`, `crop_harvest`, `pest_observation`, `general_note`, `population_adjustment`, `health`, `breeding_check`, `breeding_outcome`, `null`
- `requires_evidence` — boolean, optional
- `assigned_role` — any, optional
- `interval_value` — integer, optional, min 1, max 52. Every N days (daily) or N weeks (weekly).
- `weekdays` — array, optional, min 1 items, max 7 items, nullable. Weekly only: ISO weekdays 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). Defaults to the weekday of the start.
- `occurrence_limit` — integer, optional, min 1, max 3650, nullable

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
A read model for the calendar screen: tasks plus milestones (cycle start/expected end, breeding expected dates/windows, health follow-ups) between `from` and `to`, ordered by date then time. It stores nothing.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
The calendar screen (tasks plus milestones).

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Query filters: `from` (required), `to` (required), `production_cycle_id`, `breeding_project_id`, `category`, `assigned_to`, `include_milestones`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `task.view` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- `from` and `to` are required farm-local dates; the range is at most 92 days.
- Optional `production_cycle_id`, `breeding_project_id`, `category`, `assigned_to`, `include_milestones` (`0` hides them). Milestones are omitted when filtering by `category` or `assigned_to`.
- `meta` carries `from`, `to`, `timezone` and `today`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Needs the signed-in session cookie (send requests with credentials).
- Boolean query values: send `1`/`0` (`true`/`false` is rejected on most endpoints).
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`task.view`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `farm_worker`, `finance`, `vet`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)

**URL**
`GET {{base_url}}/calendar`

**QUERY PARAMETERS** (all optional unless marked required; booleans as `1`/`0`)
- `from` — string (date), **required**. Farm-local dates, inclusive; at most 92 days.
- `to` — string (date), **required**
- `production_cycle_id` — string (uuid)
- `breeding_project_id` — string (uuid)
- `category` — enum. Values: `feeding_watering`, `egg_collection`, `vaccination_medication`, `breeding_reproduction`, `growth_monitoring`, `record_keeping`, `maintenance_repair`, `cleaning_sanitation`, `movement_rotation`, `procurement_orders`, `irrigation`, `crop_care`, `harvest`, `payment`, `other`
- `assigned_to` — string, max 36 chars
- `include_milestones` — boolean. Set to false to list tasks only.

**BUSINESS RULES**
- `from` and `to` are required farm-local dates; the range is at most 92 days.
- Optional `production_cycle_id`, `breeding_project_id`, `category`, `assigned_to`, `include_milestones` (`0` hides them). Milestones are omitted when filtering by `category` or `assigned_to`.
- `meta` carries `from`, `to`, `timezone` and `today`.
- Requires `task.view`.

**SUCCESS**
`200 OK`

`data` is an array of objects with fields: `kind`, `date`, `end_date`, `time`, `task`.

`meta`: `from`, `to`, `timezone`, `today`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `task.view`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).

item.description:
Crop events are ordinary operational records posted to `POST /records` (land preparation, planting, establishment checks, growth stage, fertilizer, pesticide, irrigation, weeding, pest observation, crop loss, harvest) plus the crop project detail read model. Planting units are the baseline; they are not seed quantity or land area.

Typical screens: crop project activity forms (planting, fertilizer, harvest, ...) and the crop project dashboard.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Records clearing/ploughing/ridging of the plot. `treated_area` is a separate optional measurement, never planting units or stock.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Record land preparation" on a crop project.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `type`, `production_cycle_id`, `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key`, `details`.
- `recorded_at` = when it really happened (UTC, no milliseconds); `idempotency_key` = one UUID per user action.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `record.create` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Record only.
- A record says what DID happen. It is append-only: there is no PATCH or DELETE - correct with Reverse (and optionally a replacement using `corrects_record_id`).
- `recorded_at` is when the event really happened (UTC with seconds and `Z`/offset, no milliseconds, between the cycle start and now); the server keeps its own `created_at`.
- `idempotency_key` (1-80 chars of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:`, `-`) is required: same key + same payload returns the original record (201), changed payload is `409 idempotency_conflict`.

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Record planting.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`record.create`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `farm_worker`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `record-write`: 120 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/records`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `type` — enum, **required**. Values: `feed_use`, `egg_collection`, `milk`, `mortality`, `weight`, `temperature`, `water`, `irrigation`, `weeding`, `fertilizer_application`, `pesticide_application`, `land_preparation`, `planting`, `establishment_check`, `growth_stage`, `crop_loss`, `crop_harvest`, `pest_observation`, `general_note`, `population_adjustment`
- `production_cycle_id` — string (uuid), **required**
- `recorded_at` — string (date-time), **required**, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` + `Z` or `+HH:MM` (no milliseconds)
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`
- `details` — object, **required**. Type-specific object; only fields returned by /record-types/{type}/schema are accepted.
- `notes` — string, optional, max 5000 chars, nullable
- `corrects_record_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{crop_cycle_id}}` — captured by "Start a crop project"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- A record says what DID happen. It is append-only: there is no PATCH or DELETE - correct with Reverse (and optionally a replacement using `corrects_record_id`).
- `recorded_at` is when the event really happened (UTC with seconds and `Z`/offset, no milliseconds, between the cycle start and now); the server keeps its own `created_at`.
- `idempotency_key` (1-80 chars of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:`, `-`) is required: same key + same payload returns the original record (201), changed payload is `409 idempotency_conflict`.
- Never send `farm_id`, `created_by`, `population_delta` or `measurement`: the server derives them. Unknown `details` keys are rejected.

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — message: "Operational record saved."

`data` fields: `id`, `production_cycle_id`, `type`, `details`, `measurement`, `population_delta`, `recorded_at`, `notes`, `reverses_record_id`, `corrects_record_id`, `reversed_by_record_id`, `inventory_movement_id`, `created_by`, `created_at`, `attachments`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `record.create`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `404 not_found` — unknown id, or an id that belongs to another farm (never distinguishable).
- `409` — `cycle_closed`, `insufficient_population`, `population_changed`, `idempotency_conflict`, `invalid_correction`, `cycle_reconciliation_failed`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
- `419 session_expired` — missing/expired CSRF token: call "Initialise CSRF cookie" and retry once.
- `429 too_many_requests` — honour `Retry-After`.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Records harvested output. With `inventory` pointing at a `produce` item, the same transaction adds the harvested quantity to stock (one harvest = one record = one `stock_in`).

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Record harvest" on a crop project.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `type`, `production_cycle_id`, `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key`, `details`.
- `recorded_at` = when it really happened (UTC, no milliseconds); `idempotency_key` = one UUID per user action.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `record.create` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Creates the record and one `stock_in` movement (reason `harvest`) when linked. Reversing the record removes that produce (`409 insufficient_stock` if it was already used).
- A record says what DID happen. It is append-only: there is no PATCH or DELETE - correct with Reverse (and optionally a replacement using `corrects_record_id`).
- `recorded_at` is when the event really happened (UTC with seconds and `Z`/offset, no milliseconds, between the cycle start and now); the server keeps its own `created_at`.
- `idempotency_key` (1-80 chars of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:`, `-`) is required: same key + same payload returns the original record (201), changed payload is `409 idempotency_conflict`.

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Open the crop project detail to see totals.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).

- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`
- `details` — object, **required**. Type-specific object; only fields returned by /record-types/{type}/schema are accepted.
- `notes` — string, optional, max 5000 chars, nullable
- `corrects_record_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable

**VARIABLES USED**

- `{{item_yam_id}}` — captured by "Create an inventory item (harvest produce)"

**FRONTEND NOTES**

- Route by the UUIDv7 `id`; any `reference` code (`BAT-2026-00001`, ...) is display-only.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Records ONE procurement event: a supplier, a total and its lines. It is the only endpoint that writes stock AND money together, in a single transaction.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Record purchase" for stock bought from a supplier.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key`, `items`.
- `recorded_at` = when it really happened (UTC, no milliseconds); `idempotency_key` = one UUID per user action.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `purchase.create` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Creates the purchase and lines, one `stock_in` movement per stock line, and one linked expense in the money ledger (`source: purchase`).
- `stock` lines add stock (one `stock_in`, reason `purchase`, per line) using the Phase 5 components format; packages (`bag`) resolve ONLY through the item's own package conversion. `non_stock` lines (transport, services) move no stock.
- The purchase total is the exact sum of line `amount`s (`9000.00 + 1250.45 = 10250.45`); one expense is booked for the total unless `record_expense: false`. Its category is derived from the lines unless `finance_category_id` (an expense category) is sent.
- `production_cycle_id` (an OPEN cycle) allocates the cost to that cycle's profitability.

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Refetch inventory and the finance summary.

**OUTPUT-NAMED STOCK LINES (GAP-08)**
A stock line names its stock with EXACTLY ONE of `inventory_item_id` (a specific item, always supported) or `output` (`eggs` | `milk`, the farm's automatic output item; no item id needed). A PURCHASE resolves (or creates) the output item exactly like `POST /inventory/stock-in {output}`, and with no store and no active store creates "Main Store". `storage_location_id` is optional with `output` (the only active store is used; several active stores need a choice, `422 items.N.storage_location_id`). Both or neither -> `422`; `output` on a non-stock line -> `422`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.
- Refetch inventory (`GET /inventory/items/{id}`) and finance summary after saving.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`purchase.create`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `finance-write`: 240 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/purchases`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `contact_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. The supplier (an active contact with the supplier role).
- `supplier_reference` — string, optional, max 100 chars, nullable. Supplier invoice or receipt number.
- `production_cycle_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. Allocates the cost to an open production cycle.
- `record_expense` — boolean, optional. Book the purchase total as ONE expense transaction linked to this purchase (default true).
- `finance_category_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. Expense category; defaults from the lines (feed -> feed, medicine -> medicine_veterinary ...; mixed -> general_supplies).
- `corrects_purchase_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. Replace a cancelled purchase once. Needs purchase.cancel.
- `recorded_at` — string (date-time), **required**, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` + `Z` or `+HH:MM` (no milliseconds)
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`
- `notes` — string, optional, max 5000 chars, nullable
- `items` — array, **required**, min 1 items, max 30 items. 1-30 lines. Total = sum of line amounts.
- `items[].kind` — enum, **required**. stock = received into inventory through a stock-in; non_stock = a cost with no physical stock (services, transport...).. Values: `stock`, `non_stock`
- `items[].description` — string, **required**, max 190 chars, nullable. Required for non_stock lines; stock lines use the item name.
- `items[].inventory_item_id` — string (uuid), **required**. stock only.
- `items[].storage_location_id` — string (uuid), **required**
- `items[].lot_id` — string (uuid), **required**, nullable
- `items[].lot` — object, **required**
- `items[].lot.code` — string, **required**, max 100 chars
- `items[].lot.expires_on` — string (date), **required**, nullable
- `items[].components` — array, **required**, min 1 items, max 10 items
- `items[].components[].quantity` — string, **required**
- `items[].components[].unit` — string, **required**, max 32 chars
- `items[].amount` — string, **required**. What was paid for the whole line, in the farm currency, a string with at most two decimals.

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{supplier_id}}` — captured by "Create a contact (supplier)"
- `{{cycle_id}}` — captured by "Start a livestock batch"
- `{{item_feed_id}}` — captured by "Create an inventory item (feed)"
- `{{store_id}}` — captured by "Create a storage location"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- `stock` lines add stock (one `stock_in`, reason `purchase`, per line) using the Phase 5 components format; packages (`bag`) resolve ONLY through the item's own package conversion. `non_stock` lines (transport, services) move no stock.
- The purchase total is the exact sum of line `amount`s (`9000.00 + 1250.45 = 10250.45`); one expense is booked for the total unless `record_expense: false`. Its category is derived from the lines unless `finance_category_id` (an expense category) is sent.
- `production_cycle_id` (an OPEN cycle) allocates the cost to that cycle's profitability.
- Lot-tracked items need `lot_id` or `lot {code, expires_on}` on the line; an expired lot is `409 lot_expired`.
- Money is an exact decimal STRING with at most two decimals (`"1500.50"`; integers and JSON numbers with <=2 decimals are accepted), positive, at most 16 integer digits. The API adds and compares with exact decimal arithmetic and always returns two decimals. Do not use JavaScript floats for money: keep strings, or use a decimal library, and let the API do the totals.
- `idempotency_key` is required and farm-wide: identical retry returns the original purchase (201) with no second stock-in or expense; a changed payload is `409 idempotency_conflict`.
- Atomic: any failure rolls back purchase, lines, stock-ins and expense together.
- Requires `purchase.create` (Owner, Manager, Finance); a correction (`corrects_purchase_id`) also needs `purchase.cancel`.

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — message: "Purchase recorded."

`data` fields: `id`, `reference`, `status`, `contact_id`, `contact_name`, `production_cycle_id`, `supplier_reference`, `recorded_at`, `total_amount`, `currency`, `finance_category`, `records_expense`, `finance_transaction_id`, `finance_reversal_transaction_id`, `notes`, `corrects_purchase_id`, `cancelled_at`, `cancel_reason`, `items`, `created_by`, `created_at`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `purchase.create`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `404 not_found` — unknown id, or an id that belongs to another farm (never distinguishable).
- `409` — `cycle_closed`, `lot_expired`, `item_inactive`, `contact_inactive`, `idempotency_conflict`, `invalid_correction`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
- `419 session_expired` — missing/expired CSRF token: call "Initialise CSRF cookie" and retry once.
- `429 too_many_requests` — honour `Retry-After`.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Buys eggs into the farm's own Eggs stock: one purchase + one `purchase` stock-in + the expense, with the stock line naming `output: "eggs"` instead of an inventory item id.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Eggs In" with source Purchased when the cost is booked too. The item id is not needed (and is `null` until the farm has egg stock).

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires `purchase.create`. The line carries exactly one of `inventory_item_id` / `output`.
- The output item is resolved or created like `POST /inventory/stock-in {output}`; with no `storage_location_id` the only active store is used, no store creates "Main Store", several stores need a choice (422 `items.N.storage_location_id`).
- Identical retries replay the same purchase (idempotency).

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Refetch `GET /inventory/output-balances` and the purchase.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.


---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie (verified, onboarded, active member of the current farm). State-changing requests need `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required permission: **`purchase.create`**.

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/purchases`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `items[]` — `kind: stock`, `output: eggs|milk` **or** `inventory_item_id`, `storage_location_id` (optional with `output`), `components`, `amount`
- `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key` — **required**

**BUSINESS RULES**
- `output` and `inventory_item_id` together, or neither, on a stock line: 422.

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — the purchase; the line shows the resolved `inventory_item_id` and `storage_location_id`.

**ERRORS**
**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403 forbidden` — the caller lacks the permission above.
- `409 idempotency_conflict`.
- `422 validation_failed` — both/neither stock target, unknown `output`, or several stores and none chosen.

**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`).

Required backend farm permission: **`purchase.view`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)

- `production_cycle_id` — string (uuid)

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Cancels a purchase without rewriting history: one compensating stock movement per stock line and an offsetting ledger row are appended, and the purchase becomes `cancelled`.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Cancel purchase".

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Path ids (UUIDv7): `{{purchase_c_id}}`.
- Required body fields: `reason`, `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key`.
- `recorded_at` = when it really happened (UTC, no milliseconds); `idempotency_key` = one UUID per user action.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `purchase.cancel` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Compensating stock movements and an offsetting finance reversal.
- If the received stock was since used or moved the cancel is `409 insufficient_stock` and NOTHING changes. A second cancel with another key is `409 purchase_already_cancelled`.
- Correct by cancelling, then POST a new purchase with `corrects_purchase_id` (once; needs `purchase.cancel`).
- The purchase's stock and expense cannot be reversed individually (`409 reverse_via_purchase`).
- This is a correction, not an edit: history is kept and a new opposite row is appended.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Route by the UUIDv7 `id`; any `reference` code (`BAT-2026-00001`, ...) is display-only.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`purchase.cancel`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `finance-write`: 240 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/purchases/{{purchase_c_id}}/cancel`

**PATH PARAMETERS**
- `{{purchase_c_id}}` — UUID. Captured by "Record a purchase (to cancel)" (15 — Contacts & Purchasing) or from the list endpoint of this resource.

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `reason` — string, **required**, max 2000 chars
- `recorded_at` — string (date-time), **required**, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` + `Z` or `+HH:MM` (no milliseconds). When the goods were returned / the purchase was voided (explicit offset); the stock reversal is dated here.
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{purchase_c_id}}` — captured by "Record a purchase (to cancel)"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- If the received stock was since used or moved the cancel is `409 insufficient_stock` and NOTHING changes. A second cancel with another key is `409 purchase_already_cancelled`.
- Correct by cancelling, then POST a new purchase with `corrects_purchase_id` (once; needs `purchase.cancel`).
- The purchase's stock and expense cannot be reversed individually (`409 reverse_via_purchase`).
- Requires `purchase.cancel` (Owner, Manager, Finance).

**SUCCESS**
`200 OK` — message: "Purchase cancelled."

`data` fields: `id`, `reference`, `status`, `contact_id`, `contact_name`, `production_cycle_id`, `supplier_reference`, `recorded_at`, `total_amount`, `currency`, `finance_category`, `records_expense`, `finance_transaction_id`, `finance_reversal_transaction_id`, `notes`, `corrects_purchase_id`, `cancelled_at`, `cancel_reason`, `items`, `created_by`, `created_at`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `purchase.cancel`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `404 not_found` — unknown id, or an id that belongs to another farm (never distinguishable).
- `409` — `purchase_already_cancelled`, `insufficient_stock`, `cycle_closed`, `idempotency_conflict`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
- `419 session_expired` — missing/expired CSRF token: call "Initialise CSRF cookie" and retry once.
- `429 too_many_requests` — honour `Retry-After`.

Books an expense in the money ledger (`direction` is pinned to `expense`). Optionally allocate it to an open production cycle so it counts toward that cycle's profitability.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Add expense" (labour, utilities, ...).

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `amount`, `occurred_on`, `idempotency_key`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `finance.create` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- One expense row in the money ledger. No stock effect.
- Money is an exact decimal STRING with at most two decimals (`"1500.50"`; integers and JSON numbers with <=2 decimals are accepted), positive, at most 16 integer digits. The API adds and compares with exact decimal arithmetic and always returns two decimals. Do not use JavaScript floats for money: keep strings, or use a decimal library, and let the API do the totals.
- `occurred_on` is a farm-local day, not in the future; `recorded_at` (optional) is the entry time, kept apart from `created_at`.
- The category must be active and match the direction. Omit `production_cycle_id` for farm overhead.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`finance.create`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `finance-write`: 240 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/expenses`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `direction` — enum, optional. Values: `expense`
- `finance_category_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable
- `amount` — string, **required**
- `occurred_on` — string (date), **required**
- `recorded_at` — string (date-time), optional, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` + `Z` or `+HH:MM` (no milliseconds)
- `contact_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable
- `production_cycle_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable
- `description` — string, optional, max 500 chars, nullable
- `source` — object, optional
- `source.type` — enum, **required**. Values: `operational_record`, `health_record`, `purchase`
- `source.id` — string (uuid), **required**
- `corrects_transaction_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`
- `farm_id` — string, optional
- `created_by` — string, optional
- `currency` — string, optional
- `entry_type` — string, optional
- `reference` — string, optional

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{cat_labour_id}}` — captured by "List income and expense categories"
- `{{cycle_id}}` — captured by "Start a livestock batch"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- Money is an exact decimal STRING with at most two decimals (`"1500.50"`; integers and JSON numbers with <=2 decimals are accepted), positive, at most 16 integer digits. The API adds and compares with exact decimal arithmetic and always returns two decimals. Do not use JavaScript floats for money: keep strings, or use a decimal library, and let the API do the totals.
- `occurred_on` is a farm-local day, not in the future; `recorded_at` (optional) is the entry time, kept apart from `created_at`.
- The category must be active and match the direction. Omit `production_cycle_id` for farm overhead.
- Optional `source {type: operational_record|health_record|purchase, id}` links the expense to the real event: ONE live transaction per source (`409 finance_already_recorded`, `details.transaction_id`).
- Never send `farm_id`, `currency`, `created_by`, `entry_type`, `reference` (rejected).
- Requires `finance.create` (Owner, Manager, Finance). Tasks never create transactions.

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — message: "Expense recorded."

`data` fields: `id`, `reference`, `entry_type`, `direction`, `category`, `amount`, `currency`, `occurred_on`, `recorded_at`, `contact_id`, `contact_name`, `production_cycle_id`, `description`, `source`, `reverses_transaction_id`, `corrects_transaction_id`, `reversed_by_transaction_id`, `is_reversed`, `reason`, `created_by`, `created_at`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `finance.create`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `409` — `finance_already_recorded`, `source_reversed`, `cycle_closed`, `contact_inactive`, `category_inactive`, `idempotency_conflict`, `invalid_correction`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
- `419 session_expired` — missing/expired CSRF token: call "Initialise CSRF cookie" and retry once.
- `429 too_many_requests` — honour `Retry-After`.

**WHAT IT DOES**
The generic form of the two endpoints above: `direction` (`income`|`expense`) is part of the body.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
A generic income/expense entry form.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `direction`, `amount`, `occurred_on`, `idempotency_key`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
The money ledger, reversal rows included. Filters: `direction`, `entry_type` (`entry`|`reversal`), `finance_category_id`, `contact_id`, `production_cycle_id`, `source_type` (`operational_record`, `health_record`, `purchase`, `payment`), `source_id`, `from`, `to` (inclusive farm-local days), `page`, `per_page`.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
The money ledger screen.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Query filters: `direction`, `entry_type`, `finance_category_id`, `contact_id`, `production_cycle_id`, `source_type`, `source_id`, `from`, ....

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `finance.view` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Needs the signed-in session cookie (send requests with credentials).
- Boolean query values: send `1`/`0` (`true`/`false` is rejected on most endpoints).
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`finance.view`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)

**URL**
`GET {{base_url}}/finance/transactions`

**QUERY PARAMETERS** (all optional unless marked required; booleans as `1`/`0`)
- `direction` — enum. Values: `income`, `expense`
- `entry_type` — enum. Values: `entry`, `reversal`
- `finance_category_id` — string (uuid)
- `contact_id` — string (uuid)
- `production_cycle_id` — string (uuid)
- `source_type` — enum. Values: `operational_record`, `health_record`, `purchase`, `payment`
- `source_id` — string (uuid)
- `from` — string (date)
- `to` — string (date)
- `page` — integer, min 1
- `per_page` — integer, min 1, max 100

**SUCCESS**
`200 OK`

`data` is an array of objects with fields: `id`, `reference`, `entry_type`, `direction`, `category`, `amount`, `currency`, `occurred_on`, `recorded_at`, `contact_id`, `contact_name`, `production_cycle_id`, `description`, `source`, `reverses_transaction_id`, `corrects_transaction_id`, `reversed_by_transaction_id`, `is_reversed`, `reason`, `created_by`, `created_at`.

`meta`: `current_page`, `per_page`, `last_page`, `total`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `finance.view`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Appends an offsetting reversal row (same direction, category, amount, contact, cycle and source; `entry_type: "reversal"`). Totals subtract it; the original stays with `is_reversed: true`.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Undo" a manual transaction.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Path ids (UUIDv7): `{{transaction_id}}`.
- Required body fields: `reason`, `idempotency_key`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `finance.reverse` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Offsetting ledger row.
- Nothing is reversed twice (`409 transaction_already_reversed`). Allocated money in a closed cycle needs the cycle reopened (`409 cycle_closed`).
- Purchase-booked expenses must be reversed by cancelling the purchase (`409 reverse_via_purchase`); payment income by reversing the payment (`409 reverse_via_payment`).
- To replace, POST a new transaction with `corrects_transaction_id` (needs `finance.reverse`).
- This is a correction, not an edit: history is kept and a new opposite row is appended.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Route by the UUIDv7 `id`; any `reference` code (`BAT-2026-00001`, ...) is display-only.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`finance.reverse`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `finance-write`: 240 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/finance/transactions/{{transaction_id}}/reverse`

**PATH PARAMETERS**
- `{{transaction_id}}` — UUID. Captured by "Record an income or expense transaction" (16 — Finance) or from the list endpoint of this resource.

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `reason` — string, **required**, max 2000 chars
- `occurred_on` — string (date), optional. Farm-local day of the reversal (between the original day and today); defaults to today.
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{transaction_id}}` — captured by "Record an income or expense transaction"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- Nothing is reversed twice (`409 transaction_already_reversed`). Allocated money in a closed cycle needs the cycle reopened (`409 cycle_closed`).
- Purchase-booked expenses must be reversed by cancelling the purchase (`409 reverse_via_purchase`); payment income by reversing the payment (`409 reverse_via_payment`).
- To replace, POST a new transaction with `corrects_transaction_id` (needs `finance.reverse`).
- Requires `finance.reverse` (Owner, Manager, Finance).

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — message: "Reversal recorded."

`data` fields: `id`, `reference`, `entry_type`, `direction`, `category`, `amount`, `currency`, `occurred_on`, `recorded_at`, `contact_id`, `contact_name`, `production_cycle_id`, `description`, `source`, `reverses_transaction_id`, `corrects_transaction_id`, `reversed_by_transaction_id`, `is_reversed`, `reason`, `created_by`, `created_at`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `finance.reverse`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `404 not_found` — unknown id, or an id that belongs to another farm (never distinguishable).

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Records what LEFT the farm, to whom and for how much. A sale is the commercial event only: it is NOT an invoice and NOT a payment, so it books no income.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Record sale" (produce and/or animals).

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key`, `items`.
- `recorded_at` = when it really happened (UTC, no milliseconds); `idempotency_key` = one UUID per user action.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Stock lines accept items in a sellable category: `produce` (eggs, milk, harvests) and `feed` (surplus feed sold to another farm). `GET /master/inventory-options` lists them as `sellable_categories`. The sale remains the only writer of a `sale` stock-out; reason `sale` on the manual stock-out is refused.
- Requires the farm permission `sale.create` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Sale + lines; one `stock_out` per stock line; one population exit (operational record `livestock_sale`, `population_delta = -12`) per livestock line. NO invoice, NO income.
- `stock` lines sell PRODUCE items: one stock-out (`reason: sale`) per line, quantities in the components format, never below zero (`409 insufficient_stock`, `details.available/requested`). `livestock` lines remove `head_count` animals from a livestock cycle through the population ledger (`409 insufficient_population`; cycle must be open). `other` lines (description required) have no physical effect.
- Customer: `contact_id` must be an active contact with the `customer` role, or send `customer_name` for a walk-in (not both).
- `finance_category_id` (an income category) is optional; otherwise derived (livestock-only -> `livestock_sales`, produce-only -> `crop_sales`, else `other_income`) and used when payments are booked.

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Issue the invoice if the customer needs one.

**OUTPUT-NAMED STOCK LINES (GAP-08)**
A stock line names its stock with EXACTLY ONE of `inventory_item_id` (a specific item, always supported) or `output` (`eggs` | `milk`, the farm's automatic output item; no item id needed). A SALE takes the existing output item only: a farm that never stocked it gets `409 insufficient_stock` and nothing is created. `storage_location_id` is optional with `output` (the only active store is used; several active stores need a choice, `422 items.N.storage_location_id`). Both or neither -> `422`; `output` on a non-stock line -> `422`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.
- Refetch the cycle (`current_population`) and inventory stock after saving. Show `payment_status` from the sale: `uninvoiced`, `unpaid`, `partially_paid`, `paid`.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`sale.create`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `finance-write`: 240 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/sales`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `contact_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. The customer (an active contact with the customer role, Phase 14). Omit for a walk-in sale.
- `customer_name` — string, optional, max 150 chars, nullable. Free-text buyer name for a walk-in sale; not allowed together with contact_id.
- `finance_category_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. Income category later payments are booked to; defaults from the lines (livestock -> livestock_sales, produce -> crop_sales, otherwise other_income).
- `corrects_sale_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. Replace a cancelled sale once. Needs sale.cancel.
- `recorded_at` — string (date-time), **required**, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` + `Z` or `+HH:MM` (no milliseconds)
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`
- `notes` — string, optional, max 5000 chars, nullable
- `invoice` — object, optional. "Save & Create Invoice": issue the invoice for this sale in the same transaction. A convenience only - the invoice is still its own document. Needs invoice.create.
- `invoice.issue_date` — string (date), **required**, nullable
- `invoice.due_date` — string (date), **required**, nullable
- `invoice.notes` — string, **required**, max 2000 chars, nullable
- `items` — array, **required**, min 1 items, max 30 items. 1-30 lines. Total = exact sum of line amounts.
- `items[].kind` — enum, **required**. stock = produce leaving inventory through a Phase 9 stock-out; livestock = animals leaving a livestock cycle through the population ledger; other = no physical effect.. Values: `stock`, `livestock`, `other`
- `items[].description` — string, **required**, max 190 chars, nullable. Required for other lines; stock and livestock lines are named from the item/cycle (an optional label is kept for livestock).
- `items[].inventory_item_id` — string (uuid), **required**. stock only.
- `items[].storage_location_id` — string (uuid), **required**
- `items[].lot_id` — string (uuid), **required**, nullable
- `items[].components` — array, **required**, min 1 items, max 10 items
- `items[].components[].quantity` — string, **required**
- `items[].components[].unit` — string, **required**, max 32 chars
- `items[].production_cycle_id` — string (uuid), **required**, nullable. Required for livestock lines (the cycle the animals leave); optional revenue allocation for the others.
- `items[].head_count` — string, **required**. livestock only: whole animals sold.
- `items[].amount` — string, **required**. What the buyer pays for the whole line, in the farm currency, a string with at most two decimals.

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{customer_id}}` — captured by "Create a contact (customer)"
- `{{item_eggs_id}}` — captured by "Create an inventory item (produce)"
- `{{store_id}}` — captured by "Create a storage location"
- `{{cycle_id}}` — captured by "Start a livestock batch"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- `stock` lines sell PRODUCE items: one stock-out (`reason: sale`) per line, quantities in the components format, never below zero (`409 insufficient_stock`, `details.available/requested`). `livestock` lines remove `head_count` animals from a livestock cycle through the population ledger (`409 insufficient_population`; cycle must be open). `other` lines (description required) have no physical effect.
- Customer: `contact_id` must be an active contact with the `customer` role, or send `customer_name` for a walk-in (not both).
- `finance_category_id` (an income category) is optional; otherwise derived (livestock-only -> `livestock_sales`, produce-only -> `crop_sales`, else `other_income`) and used when payments are booked.
- Optional `invoice {issue_date, due_date, notes}` is "Save & create invoice": it runs the invoice step in the same transaction (also needs `invoice.create`). The two documents stay separate.
- Money is an exact decimal STRING with at most two decimals (`"1500.50"`; integers and JSON numbers with <=2 decimals are accepted), positive, at most 16 integer digits. The API adds and compares with exact decimal arithmetic and always returns two decimals. Do not use JavaScript floats for money: keep strings, or use a decimal library, and let the API do the totals.
- `idempotency_key` is required and farm-wide: identical retry returns the original sale (201); changed payload is `409 idempotency_conflict`. Atomic.
- Requires `sale.create` (Owner, Manager, Finance).

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — message: "Sale recorded."

`data` fields: `id`, `reference`, `status`, `contact_id`, `customer_name`, `recorded_at`, `total_amount`, `currency`, `finance_category`, `payment_status`, `amount_paid`, `outstanding`, `invoice`, `notes`, `corrects_sale_id`, `cancelled_at`, `cancel_reason`, `items`, `created_by`, `created_at`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `sale.create`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `404 not_found` — unknown id, or an id that belongs to another farm (never distinguishable).
- `409` — `insufficient_stock`, `insufficient_population`, `cycle_closed`, `lot_expired`, `item_inactive`, `contact_inactive`, `idempotency_conflict`, `invalid_correction`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
- `419 session_expired` — missing/expired CSRF token: call "Initialise CSRF cookie" and retry once.
- `429 too_many_requests` — honour `Retry-After`.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Sells surplus feed to another farm or a distributor: one sale + one `sale` stock-out (linked to the line). Feed is a sellable category on its own; it is not relabelled as produce.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
Feed Out → Sold.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires `sale.create`. Cancel with `POST /sales/{id}/cancel` to restore the stock. Stock-only feed sales are booked to `other_income`.
- Medicine, seed, agrochemicals and general supplies are not sellable (422).

**OUTPUT-NAMED STOCK LINES (GAP-08)**
A stock line names its stock with EXACTLY ONE of `inventory_item_id` (a specific item, always supported) or `output` (`eggs` | `milk`, the farm's automatic output item; no item id needed). A SALE takes the existing output item only: a farm that never stocked it gets `409 insufficient_stock` and nothing is created. `storage_location_id` is optional with `output` (the only active store is used; several active stores need a choice, `422 items.N.storage_location_id`). Both or neither -> `422`; `output` on a non-stock line -> `422`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.


---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie (verified, onboarded, active member of the current farm). State-changing requests need `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required permission: **`sale.create`**.

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/sales`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `items[]` of `kind: stock` with `inventory_item_id` (feed or produce), `storage_location_id`, `components`, `amount`

**BUSINESS RULES**
- The manual stock-out reason `sale` stays refused.

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — the sale.

**ERRORS**
**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403 forbidden` — the caller lacks the permission above.
- `409 insufficient_stock`, `idempotency_conflict`.
- `422 items.0.inventory_item_id` — category not sellable.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
The sale with lines and the effect each caused (`inventory_movement_id` / `operational_record_id`), plus `payment_status`, `amount_paid`, `outstanding` (null while uninvoiced) and `invoice {id, reference, status}`.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
A sale detail with lines, payment status and outstanding amount.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Path ids (UUIDv7): `{{sale_id}}`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `sale.view` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Needs the signed-in session cookie (send requests with credentials).
- Route by the UUIDv7 `id`; any `reference` code (`BAT-2026-00001`, ...) is display-only.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`sale.view`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)

**URL**
`GET {{base_url}}/sales/{{sale_id}}`

**PATH PARAMETERS**
- `{{sale_id}}` — UUID. Captured by "Record a sale (stock + livestock lines)" (17 — Sales, Invoices & Payments) or from the list endpoint of this resource.

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{sale_id}}` — captured by "Record a sale (stock + livestock lines)"

**SUCCESS**
`200 OK`

`data` fields: `id`, `reference`, `status`, `contact_id`, `customer_name`, `recorded_at`, `total_amount`, `currency`, `finance_category`, `payment_status`, `amount_paid`, `outstanding`, `invoice`, `notes`, `corrects_sale_id`, `cancelled_at`, `cancel_reason`, `items`, `created_by`, `created_at`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `sale.view`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `404 not_found` — unknown id, or an id that belongs to another farm (never distinguishable).

**WHAT IT DOES**
Creates the customer DOCUMENT for a sale. The invoice snapshots the customer, seller, currency, total and every line when issued, so later edits to contacts or items never change it. It books nothing.

**WHEN TO USE IT**

- Creates the invoice and its snapshot lines. No income, no stock or population effect.
- One live invoice per sale: `409 invoice_exists`. A cancelled sale cannot be invoiced (`409 sale_cancelled`). `issue_date` defaults to today (between the sale day and today); `due_date` >= issue date.
- Void an invoice with `POST /invoices/{id}/void`; the sale can then be invoiced again.

- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

---

**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`invoice.create`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/sales/{{sale_id}}/invoice`

- `{{sale_id}}` — UUID. Captured by "Record a sale (stock + livestock lines)" (17 — Sales, Invoices & Payments) or from the list endpoint of this resource.

- `sale_id` — string (uuid), **required**. The sale to invoice. Required on POST /invoices; taken from the URL on POST /sales/{sale}/invoice.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Records MONEY RECEIVED against an invoice. This is the moment income is booked (cash basis): one payment appends exactly one income row to the money ledger (`source: payment`).

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Record payment" on an invoice (partial or full).

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Path ids (UUIDv7): `{{invoice_id}}`.
- Required body fields: `amount`, `method`, `received_on`, `idempotency_key`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `payment.create` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Creates the payment and ONE income ledger row. Sale and invoice are unchanged except their derived `payment_status`/balance.
- `method`: `cash`, `bank_transfer`, `pos`, `mobile_money`, `cheque`, `other`. `received_on` is a farm-local day (not in the future, not before the sale).
- Partial and multiple payments are normal. A payment can never exceed the balance: `409 payment_exceeds_balance` (`details.outstanding`). A void invoice accepts none (`409 invoice_void`).
- Income uses the sale's category unless `finance_category_id` (an income category) is sent, and is allocated to a cycle only when all sale lines belong to ONE open cycle.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Route by the UUIDv7 `id`; any `reference` code (`BAT-2026-00001`, ...) is display-only.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.
- Refetch the invoice and sale after paying; do not compute balances client-side.

---

**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`payment.create`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `finance-write`: 240 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/invoices/{{invoice_id}}/payments`

**PATH PARAMETERS**
- `{{invoice_id}}` — UUID. Captured by "Issue the invoice for a sale" (17 — Sales, Invoices & Payments) or from the list endpoint of this resource.

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `amount` — string, **required**. Money actually received, in the farm currency, a string with at most two decimals; may not exceed the invoice balance.
- `method` — enum, **required**. Values: `cash`, `bank_transfer`, `pos`, `mobile_money`, `cheque`, `other`
- `payment_reference` — string, optional, max 100 chars, nullable. Bank/transfer/receipt reference.
- `received_on` — string (date), **required**. Farm-local day the money was received; not in the future.
- `recorded_at` — string (date-time), optional, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` + `Z` or `+HH:MM` (no milliseconds). When it was entered (explicit offset); defaults to now. Kept separate from created_at.
- `finance_category_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. Income category for the ledger entry; defaults to the sale category.
- `notes` — string, optional, max 2000 chars, nullable
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{invoice_id}}` — captured by "Issue the invoice for a sale"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- `method`: `cash`, `bank_transfer`, `pos`, `mobile_money`, `cheque`, `other`. `received_on` is a farm-local day (not in the future, not before the sale).
- Partial and multiple payments are normal. A payment can never exceed the balance: `409 payment_exceeds_balance` (`details.outstanding`). A void invoice accepts none (`409 invoice_void`).
- Income uses the sale's category unless `finance_category_id` (an income category) is sent, and is allocated to a cycle only when all sale lines belong to ONE open cycle.
- Money is an exact decimal STRING with at most two decimals (`"1500.50"`; integers and JSON numbers with <=2 decimals are accepted), positive, at most 16 integer digits. The API adds and compares with exact decimal arithmetic and always returns two decimals. Do not use JavaScript floats for money: keep strings, or use a decimal library, and let the API do the totals.
- `idempotency_key` is required: identical retry returns the original payment (201) with no second income row.
- Requires `payment.create` (Owner, Manager, Finance).

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — message: "Payment recorded."

`data` fields: `id`, `reference`, `entry_type`, `invoice_id`, `invoice_reference`, `amount`, `currency`, `method`, `payment_reference`, `received_on`, `recorded_at`, `notes`, `finance_transaction_id`, `reverses_payment_id`, `reversed_by_payment_id`, `is_reversed`, `reason`, `created_by`, `created_at`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `payment.create`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `404 not_found` — unknown id, or an id that belongs to another farm (never distinguishable).
- `409` — `payment_exceeds_balance`, `invoice_void`, `category_inactive`, `idempotency_conflict`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
- `419 session_expired` — missing/expired CSRF token: call "Initialise CSRF cookie" and retry once.
- `429 too_many_requests` — honour `Retry-After`.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
"Save & create invoice": the `invoice` block issues the invoice in the same transaction. The sale and the invoice are still two separate resources with their own lifecycles.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Save & create invoice" in one step.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key`, `items`.
- `recorded_at` = when it really happened (UTC, no milliseconds); `idempotency_key` = one UUID per user action.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `sale.create` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Sale, `other` line (no physical effect) and invoice. No income.
- The `invoice` block runs the invoice step in the same transaction (needs `invoice.create` too); the response contains `invoice {id, reference, status}`.
- `other` lines (description required) have no physical effect. Money rules as in the main example.

**OUTPUT-NAMED STOCK LINES (GAP-08)**
A stock line names its stock with EXACTLY ONE of `inventory_item_id` (a specific item, always supported) or `output` (`eggs` | `milk`, the farm's automatic output item; no item id needed). A SALE takes the existing output item only: a farm that never stocked it gets `409 insufficient_stock` and nothing is created. `storage_location_id` is optional with `output` (the only active store is used; several active stores need a choice, `422 items.N.storage_location_id`). Both or neither -> `422`; `output` on a non-stock line -> `422`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`sale.create`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `finance`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `finance-write`: 240 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/sales`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `contact_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. The customer (an active contact with the customer role, Phase 14). Omit for a walk-in sale.
- `customer_name` — string, optional, max 150 chars, nullable. Free-text buyer name for a walk-in sale; not allowed together with contact_id.
- `finance_category_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. Income category later payments are booked to; defaults from the lines (livestock -> livestock_sales, produce -> crop_sales, otherwise other_income).
- `corrects_sale_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable. Replace a cancelled sale once. Needs sale.cancel.
- `recorded_at` — string (date-time), **required**, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` + `Z` or `+HH:MM` (no milliseconds)
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`
- `notes` — string, optional, max 5000 chars, nullable
- `invoice` — object, optional. "Save & Create Invoice": issue the invoice for this sale in the same transaction. A convenience only - the invoice is still its own document. Needs invoice.create.
- `invoice.issue_date` — string (date), **required**, nullable
- `invoice.due_date` — string (date), **required**, nullable
- `invoice.notes` — string, **required**, max 2000 chars, nullable
- `items` — array, **required**, min 1 items, max 30 items. 1-30 lines. Total = exact sum of line amounts.
- `items[].kind` — enum, **required**. stock = produce leaving inventory through a Phase 9 stock-out; livestock = animals leaving a livestock cycle through the population ledger; other = no physical effect.. Values: `stock`, `livestock`, `other`
- `items[].description` — string, **required**, max 190 chars, nullable. Required for other lines; stock and livestock lines are named from the item/cycle (an optional label is kept for livestock).
- `items[].inventory_item_id` — string (uuid), **required**. stock only.
- `items[].storage_location_id` — string (uuid), **required**
- `items[].lot_id` — string (uuid), **required**, nullable
- `items[].components` — array, **required**, min 1 items, max 10 items
- `items[].components[].quantity` — string, **required**
- `items[].components[].unit` — string, **required**, max 32 chars
- `items[].production_cycle_id` — string (uuid), **required**, nullable. Required for livestock lines (the cycle the animals leave); optional revenue allocation for the others.
- `items[].head_count` — string, **required**. livestock only: whole animals sold.
- `items[].amount` — string, **required**. What the buyer pays for the whole line, in the farm currency, a string with at most two decimals.

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{customer_id}}` — captured by "Create a contact (customer)"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- The `invoice` block runs the invoice step in the same transaction (needs `invoice.create` too); the response contains `invoice {id, reference, status}`.
- `other` lines (description required) have no physical effect. Money rules as in the main example.

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — message: "Sale recorded."

`data` fields: `id`, `reference`, `status`, `contact_id`, `customer_name`, `recorded_at`, `total_amount`, `currency`, `finance_category`, `payment_status`, `amount_paid`, `outstanding`, `invoice`, `notes`, `corrects_sale_id`, `cancelled_at`, `cancel_reason`, `items`, `created_by`, `created_at`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `sale.create`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `404 not_found` — unknown id, or an id that belongs to another farm (never distinguishable).
- `409` — `insufficient_stock`, `insufficient_population`, `cycle_closed`, `lot_expired`, `item_inactive`, `contact_inactive`, `idempotency_conflict`, `invalid_correction`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
- `419 session_expired` — missing/expired CSRF token: call "Initialise CSRF cookie" and retry once.
- `429 too_many_requests` — honour `Retry-After`.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Appends an offsetting payment row (`entry_type: "reversal"`) and an offsetting income row; the invoice balance goes back up. Wrong amounts are corrected by reversing and recording a new payment.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Reverse payment" (bounced/incorrect).

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Path ids (UUIDv7): `{{payment_b_id}}`.
- Required body fields: `reason`, `idempotency_key`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `payment.reverse` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Offsetting payment and income rows; invoice balance restored.
- `409 payment_already_reversed`; `409 cycle_closed` when the income was allocated to a cycle that is now closed.
- The income row cannot be reversed through the finance endpoint (`409 reverse_via_payment`).
- This is a correction, not an edit: history is kept and a new opposite row is appended.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
The whole command centre for THIS farm and THIS viewer, in one call: `farm` (with `today` and `timezone`), `viewer`, `operations`, `sections`, `priority` insights, `kpis`, `work`, `calendar` strip, `quick_record`, `production`, `insights`, `recent_activity`, `quick_add` and an `empty_state`.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
The home screen; refetch after ledger-affecting actions.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- None (no body or query parameters are required).

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Cards depend on the farm's operations and on what the viewer may see; a crop-only farm gets no population or egg cards.
- It is a READ MODEL: nothing is stored; every figure is read live from the owning module and reversed/cancelled events never count.
- Every block is gated by the viewer's own permissions, not by role names: a Farm Worker never receives money cards. `sections` says which blocks the viewer may see. The endpoint never returns 403.
- Operation-aware: a crop-only farm gets no population or egg cards. A brand-new farm gets `kpis: []` and an `empty_state` with suggested actions.

**ROUTE FORMS (GAP-06)**
`quick_add[].endpoint` is the absolute `/api/v1/...` URL (unchanged); `quick_add[].url` repeats it and `quick_add[].path` is the same route relative to `{{base_url}}`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Needs the signed-in session cookie (send requests with credentials).
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Render cards from `kpis` generically (code/label/value/unit) and refetch after any ledger-affecting action.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`).

**ACCESS**
Any active farm member (no specific permission). The response is filtered by the caller's own permissions.

**URL**
`GET {{base_url}}/dashboard`

**BUSINESS RULES**
- It is a READ MODEL: nothing is stored; every figure is read live from the owning module and reversed/cancelled events never count.
- Every block is gated by the viewer's own permissions, not by role names: a Farm Worker never receives money cards. `sections` says which blocks the viewer may see. The endpoint never returns 403.
- Operation-aware: a crop-only farm gets no population or egg cards. A brand-new farm gets `kpis: []` and an `empty_state` with suggested actions.
- KPI `value` is a STRING (count, quantity or two-decimal money). `breakdown` lists `{unit, quantity}`: quantities of different units are never added.
- "Today", "last 7 days" and "this month" are farm-local days (`farm.today`), not UTC days.
- `quick_add` items carry the `permission`, `method` and `endpoint` to call.

**SUCCESS**
`200 OK`

`data` fields: `farm`, `viewer`, `operations`, `sections`, `priority`, `kpis`, `work`, `calendar`, `quick_record`, `production`, `insights`, `recent_activity`, `quick_add`, `empty_state`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Per-day task and milestone summary (`tasks {open, overdue, due_today, upcoming, completed}` and `milestones`) for a window starting at `from` (default today) of `days` (1-31, default 7) days.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
The calendar strip of the home screen.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Query filters: `from`, `days`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `task.view` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- `days` outside 1-31 or a malformed `from` is `422`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Needs the signed-in session cookie (send requests with credentials).
- Boolean query values: send `1`/`0` (`true`/`false` is rejected on most endpoints).
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`task.view`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `farm_worker`, `finance`, `vet`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)

**URL**
`GET {{base_url}}/dashboard/calendar`

**QUERY PARAMETERS** (all optional unless marked required; booleans as `1`/`0`)
- `from` — string (date). First farm-local day of the strip (default: today in the farm's timezone).
- `days` — integer, min 1, max 31. Number of days, 1-31 (default 7).

**BUSINESS RULES**
- Requires `task.view`. Cancelled tasks are not counted; a window milestone appears on every day it covers.
- `days` outside 1-31 or a malformed `from` is `422`.

**SUCCESS**
`200 OK`

`data` fields: `from`, `to`, `timezone`, `today`, `days`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `task.view`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
