request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Defines what a package holds IN A CONTEXT: one crate of eggs = 30 pieces. A bag or crate has no universal size, so the context (`context_type` + `context_id`) is mandatory.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Define package size" (e.g. 1 crate = 30 pieces), often after `conversion_not_configured`.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `context_type`, `context_id`, `package_unit`, `target_unit`, `quantity_per_package`.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `measurement.manage` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Links a package unit to a target unit inside one context (dimension `package` -> a weight/volume/count unit). Past records keep their own conversion snapshot.
- `context_type` is `crop_type` (id from `GET /master/crops`), `custom` (id from measurement contexts) or `inventory_item` (an inventory item's id).
- One definition per (context, package): a second POST is `409 conversion_exists` - PATCH it instead.
- `quantity_per_package` is an exact decimal STRING; a count target (`piece`, `egg`) needs a whole number.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`measurement.manage`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `measurement-write`: 60 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/settings/package-conversions`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `context_type` — enum, **required**. What a package conversion is about. The context is what makes "1 bag = ? kg" answerable: a bag of maize and a bag of feed differ. Stored as a (type, id) pair - the id always identifies a real, validated entity, never display text - so later phases can add their own types (for example `inventory_item`, id = the item's UUID) without a schema change. . Values: `crop_type`, `inventory_item`, `custom`
- `context_id` — string, **required**, max 36 chars. Existence/ownership is checked in PackageConversionService::resolveContext (crop type, or this farm's context).
- `package_unit` — string, **required**, max 32 chars
- `target_unit` — string, **required**, max 32 chars
- `quantity_per_package` — string, **required**

Server-owned fields — NOT accepted, sending any of them is a `422`: `farm_id`, `context_label`, `crop_type_id`.

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{context_id}}` — captured by "Create a measurement context"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- `context_type` is `crop_type` (id from `GET /master/crops`), `custom` (id from measurement contexts) or `inventory_item` (an inventory item's id).
- One definition per (context, package): a second POST is `409 conversion_exists` - PATCH it instead.
- `quantity_per_package` is an exact decimal STRING; a count target (`piece`, `egg`) needs a whole number.
- Requires `measurement.manage`.

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — message: "Package conversion created."

`data` fields: `id`, `context`, `package_unit`, `target_unit`, `quantity_per_package`, `version`, `is_active`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `measurement.manage`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `409` — A definition already exists for this package in this context.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
- `419 session_expired` — missing/expired CSRF token: call "Initialise CSRF cookie" and retry once.
- `429 too_many_requests` — honour `Retry-After`.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Returns the inventory option catalogue: item categories, the categories a sale may sell (`sellable_categories`), movement types, every stock-in / stock-out reason code, and `reasons` - the human labels and routing for each kind of stock.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
Build the Feed / Eggs / Milk "In" and "Out" screens from `reasons.by_item_kind.{feed|eggs|milk|general}.{in|out}`: render each entry's `label`, and call its `route` (the authoritative endpoint). Nothing about which reason belongs to which stock should be hard-coded.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires `inventory.view`.
- `manual: true` reasons are accepted on `POST /inventory/stock-in|stock-out`; `manual: false` ones (sale, production_use, incubation, returned) are recorded by `POST /sales`, `POST /records` (feed_use), `POST /breeding-projects` and are refused (422) on the manual endpoints so an event is entered once.
- `creates_operational_record` tells you which events create a record (only egg_collection, milk and feed_use do).
- `legacy: true` reasons (`use`, `expired`, `wasted`) are kept for existing clients.

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Use `GET /inventory/output-balances` for the eggs / milk balance card.

See `docs/api/FEED-EGGS-MILK-STOCK.md`.

**FLAT LISTS ARE NOT ITEM-AWARE (GAP-05)**
`reasons.by_item_kind` is authoritative. The flat `reasons.in` / `reasons.out` lists are deprecated (`reasons.flat_lists.deprecated: true`): their `manual` only means "not system-only" (e.g. `production` is `manual: true` there, true for feed, false for eggs/milk). Each flat entry now has `manual_for_kinds` (derived from `by_item_kind`): the item kinds for which the reason is really enterable by hand.

**ROUTES (GAP-06)**
Every `route` / `also` entry keeps its relative `path` (relative to `{{base_url}}`) and now also carries `url` (the same route as an absolute `/api/v1/...` URL).

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Records eggs collected as an entered compound quantity. With the "Eggs" context where 1 crate = 30 pieces, 3 crates + 14 pieces is stored as 104 pieces.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Record egg collection" on a laying batch.

**IMPORTANT INPUTS**
- Required body fields: `type`, `production_cycle_id`, `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key`, `details`.
- `recorded_at` = when it really happened (UTC, no milliseconds); `idempotency_key` = one UUID per user action.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires the farm permission `record.create` (taken from the current farm context; never sent by the client).
- Creates the record AND, in the same transaction, one stock-in of the normalized quantity (104 pieces, reason `production`) on the farm's own Eggs item - there is no item to set up. Requires `inventory.use` as well. `details.inventory.storage_location_id` picks the store (optional with one active store; a "Main Store" is created when the farm has none; required when several exist).
- The Eggs balance is derived from movements: `GET /inventory/output-balances`. Donated or purchased eggs are never an egg_collection (use `POST /inventory/stock-in` with `output: eggs`).
- A record says what DID happen. It is append-only: there is no PATCH or DELETE - correct with Reverse (and optionally a replacement using `corrects_record_id`).
- `recorded_at` is when the event really happened (UTC with seconds and `Z`/offset, no milliseconds, between the cycle start and now); the server keeps its own `created_at`.
- `idempotency_key` (1-80 chars of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:`, `-`) is required: same key + same payload returns the original record (201), changed payload is `409 idempotency_conflict`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie. The user must be verified, onboarded and an ACTIVE member of the current farm (oldest active membership, or `X-Farm-Id`). State-changing: needs the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required backend farm permission: **`record.create`** — granted to: `owner`, `manager`, `farm_worker`. (Documentation only: the request never contains a permission string.)
Rate limited by limiter `record-write`: 120 per hour per user (`429 too_many_requests` + `Retry-After`).

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/records`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `type` — enum, **required**. Values: `feed_use`, `egg_collection`, `milk`, `mortality`, `weight`, `temperature`, `water`, `irrigation`, `weeding`, `fertilizer_application`, `pesticide_application`, `land_preparation`, `planting`, `establishment_check`, `growth_stage`, `crop_loss`, `crop_harvest`, `pest_observation`, `general_note`, `population_adjustment`
- `production_cycle_id` — string (uuid), **required**
- `recorded_at` — string (date-time), **required**, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` + `Z` or `+HH:MM` (no milliseconds)
- `idempotency_key` — string, **required**, max 80 chars, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`
- `details` — object, **required**. Type-specific object; only fields returned by /record-types/{type}/schema are accepted.
- `notes` — string, optional, max 5000 chars, nullable
- `corrects_record_id` — string (uuid), optional, nullable

**VARIABLES USED**
- `{{cycle_id}}` — captured by "Start a livestock batch"
- `{{context_id}}` — captured by "Create a measurement context"

**BUSINESS RULES**
- A record says what DID happen. It is append-only: there is no PATCH or DELETE - correct with Reverse (and optionally a replacement using `corrects_record_id`).
- `recorded_at` is when the event really happened (UTC with seconds and `Z`/offset, no milliseconds, between the cycle start and now); the server keeps its own `created_at`.
- `idempotency_key` (1-80 chars of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:`, `-`) is required: same key + same payload returns the original record (201), changed payload is `409 idempotency_conflict`.
- Never send `farm_id`, `created_by`, `population_delta` or `measurement`: the server derives them. Unknown `details` keys are rejected.
- Closed cycle: `409 cycle_closed`. Writes are rate limited (120/hour/user).
- A package unit (crate) REQUIRES `details.context` `{type, id}` with a configured conversion; otherwise `422 conversion_context_required` / `conversion_not_configured`. The API never assumes a crate size.
- The record keeps `measurement.entered`, `normalized` and a self-contained `snapshot`, so later conversion edits never change it.
- Requires the species capability `produces_eggs`.

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — message: "Operational record saved."

`data` fields: `id`, `production_cycle_id`, `type`, `details`, `measurement`, `population_delta`, `recorded_at`, `notes`, `reverses_record_id`, `corrects_record_id`, `reversed_by_record_id`, `inventory_movement_id`, `created_by`, `created_at`, `attachments`.

**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403` — `forbidden` when the caller lacks `record.create`; other codes: `account_suspended`, `email_verification_required`, `onboarding_required`, `no_active_farm`, `farm_access_denied`.
- `404 not_found` — unknown id, or an id that belongs to another farm (never distinguishable).
- `409` — `cycle_closed`, `insufficient_population`, `population_changed`, `idempotency_conflict`, `invalid_correction`, `cycle_reconciliation_failed`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `errors` is keyed by field (nested keys like `details.quantity`); some domain rules return a specific `code` (for example measurement errors).
- `419 session_expired` — missing/expired CSRF token: call "Initialise CSRF cookie" and retry once.
- `429 too_many_requests` — honour `Retry-After`.

**WHAT IT DOES**
Returns the farm's available eggs and milk, derived from the movement ledger, with the per-store split and the item id.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
The "Eggs available / Milk available" card. Production totals ("eggs collected today: 104") come from the dashboard / reports and are a separate, equally true number: 104 collected and 44 available can both be right.

- Requires `inventory.view`.
- Read-only: it never creates the Eggs / Milk item or a Main Store. `exists: false` and a zero balance means nothing was stocked yet.
- `inventory_item_id` is the item to configure package conversions on (`POST /settings/package-conversions`, `context_type: inventory_item`) and to sell (`POST /sales` stock line).

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Sell with `POST /sales`, put eggs into incubation with `POST /breeding-projects`, give away / write off with `POST /inventory/stock-out` (`output`).

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Takes eggs out of stock for a reason other than a sale or incubation: damaged, spoiled, used at home, lost, given away.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
"Eggs Out" with reason Damaged / Broken, Spoiled, Personal / Internal use, Lost / Stolen, Gift / Donation or Other.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires `inventory.use`. One `stock_out`; no sale, income or record.
- `sale` and `incubation` are refused here (422) and name the endpoint to use.
- Never negative stock (409 `insufficient_stock`).

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Refetch `GET /inventory/output-balances`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.


---
**REFERENCE (detail)**

**AUTHENTICATION**
**Required** — Sanctum session cookie (verified, onboarded, active member of the current farm). State-changing requests need `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required permission: **`inventory.use`**.

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/inventory/stock-out`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `output` / `inventory_item_id` — exactly one
- `storage_location_id` — uuid (optional with `output`)
- `reason` — `damaged`, `spoiled`, `internal_use`, `lost`, `donation`, `other`
- `components[]`, `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key` — **required**
- `notes` — optional

**BUSINESS RULES**
- 1 crate = 30 eggs only when the Eggs item has a crate conversion.

**SUCCESS**
`201 Created` — the movement (see `reason_label`).

**ERRORS**
**ERRORS**
- `401 unauthenticated` — no valid session: show the login screen.
- `403 forbidden` — the caller lacks the permission above.
- `409 insufficient_stock`, `409 idempotency_conflict`.
- `422 validation_failed` — `sale` / `incubation` use their own endpoint.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Returns the farm's available eggs and milk, derived from the movement ledger, with the per-store split and the item id.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
The "Eggs available / Milk available" card. Production totals ("eggs collected today: 104") come from the dashboard / reports and are a separate, equally true number: 104 collected and 44 available can both be right.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires `inventory.view`.
- Read-only: it never creates the Eggs / Milk item or a Main Store. `exists: false` and a zero balance means nothing was stocked yet.
- `inventory_item_id` is the item to configure package conversions on (`POST /settings/package-conversions`, `context_type: inventory_item`) and to sell (`POST /sales` stock line).

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Sell with `POST /sales`, put eggs into incubation with `POST /breeding-projects`, give away / write off with `POST /inventory/stock-out` (`output`).

- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

Required permission: **`inventory.view`**.

**URL**
`GET {{base_url}}/inventory/output-balances`

- Balance = SUM of `inventory_movements.quantity_delta`; never edited.

**WHAT IT DOES**
Sells eggs from the farm's own Eggs stock: one sale + one `sale` stock-out (linked to the line), the line naming `output: "eggs"` instead of an inventory item id.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
Eggs Out → Sold. No item id is needed, so there is nothing to look up first.

- Requires `sale.create`. The line carries exactly one of `inventory_item_id` / `output`.
- A sale takes the EXISTING output item only: a farm that never stocked eggs gets `409 insufficient_stock` and nothing is created. Insufficient stock is `409` as for any item.
- With no `storage_location_id` the only active store is used (several = 422 `items.N.storage_location_id`).
- Cancel with `POST /sales/{id}/cancel` to restore the stock.

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Refetch `GET /inventory/output-balances`, the sale and the dashboard.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.

- Identical retries replay the same purchase (idempotency).

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**
Refetch `GET /inventory/output-balances` and the purchase.

- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).

- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

- `recorded_at`, `idempotency_key` — **required**

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Sells surplus feed to another farm or a distributor: one sale + one `sale` stock-out (linked to the line). Feed is a sellable category on its own; it is not relabelled as produce.

**WHEN TO USE IT**
Feed Out → Sold.

**IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR**
- Requires `sale.create`. Cancel with `POST /sales/{id}/cancel` to restore the stock. Stock-only feed sales are booked to `other_income`.
- Medicine, seed, agrochemicals and general supplies are not sellable (422).

**OUTPUT-NAMED STOCK LINES (GAP-08)**
A stock line names its stock with EXACTLY ONE of `inventory_item_id` (a specific item, always supported) or `output` (`eggs` | `milk`, the farm's automatic output item; no item id needed). A SALE takes the existing output item only: a farm that never stocked it gets `409 insufficient_stock` and nothing is created. `storage_location_id` is optional with `output` (the only active store is used; several active stores need a choice, `422 items.N.storage_location_id`). Both or neither -> `422`; `output` on a non-stock line -> `422`.

**FRONTEND NOTES**
- Cookie session + CSRF: send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script does it; call `GET /auth/csrf-cookie` first).
- Unit codes come from `GET /master/units?dimension=...`; do not hard-code them.
- Permissions come from the current farm context (`GET /farm` → `membership.permissions`); optional `X-Farm-Id` selects another farm you belong to.
- Derived numbers (population, stock, outstanding, totals) are authoritative on the server: refetch the affected resource and the dashboard after saving.

**Required** — Sanctum session cookie (verified, onboarded, active member of the current farm). State-changing requests need `X-XSRF-TOKEN` and a stateful `Origin` (the collection script adds both).

**ACCESS**
Required permission: **`sale.create`**.

**URL**
`POST {{base_url}}/sales`

**REQUEST BODY** (`application/json`)
- `items[]` of `kind: stock` with `inventory_item_id` (feed or produce), `storage_location_id`, `components`, `amount`

- The manual stock-out reason `sale` stays refused.

**ERRORS**

- `403 forbidden` — the caller lacks the permission above.
- `409 insufficient_stock`, `idempotency_conflict`.
- `422 items.0.inventory_item_id` — category not sellable.

request.description:
**WHAT IT DOES**
Creates a private `draft`. Money and quantities are decimal strings. Needs `listing.manage` (owner, manager, staff).

**INPUTS**
- `title`, `product_kind`, `unit` (allowed for the kind), `unit_price` (naira per ONE unit, <=2 decimals), `available_quantity` (seller-declared; whole numbers for `head`).
- Product: `species_id` / `crop_type_id` from `product-options`, or `custom_product_name` (required for `other`).
- Optional: `min_order_quantity` (<= available), `negotiable`, `package` (REQUIRED for container units), `fulfilment` (`pickup|seller_delivery|both`), `pickup_area`, `delivery_coverage[]`, `dispatch_estimate`, `delivery_charge`, `state/city/area` (default from the shop), `catalog_image_id`, `inventory_item_id` (farm-backed shops).

**ERRORS**
`403`, `404` (not a member), `409 shop_suspended`, `422` (`unit`, `unit_price`, `available_quantity`, `min_order_quantity`, `package`, `species_id`, ...). An image is NOT required.

request.description:
**IN THIS FLOW**
Lifting never republishes: the seller decides.

`listing.publish` (owner, manager; never staff). `draft|paused -> published`, immediately and without admin approval, but only while the shop is `active` (`409 shop_not_active`) and the listing is complete (`422 listing_incomplete`, `details.missing`). No image is required. Repeating the call is a no-op. Publishing never reserves or deducts stock.

item.name: Flow 17 — Marketplace deals
item.description: Staff, manager, two buyers and a seller -> approved shop with a private contact -> a negotiable listing offering pickup or delivery. DOOR A: offer -> manager accepts -> buyer confirms the deal (a pending offer, a seller and a stranger all refused) -> frozen terms, unknown delivery charge shown as "To be agreed directly" -> contact released only on the audited endpoint -> self-reported two-sided completion. DOOR B: purchase request -> staff refused -> manager confirms (no agreement, no contact, idempotent) -> buyer confirms the exact terms -> pickup address disclosed -> cancel ends contact -> report after cancellation (invisible to the seller) -> platform admin read-only review with audited contact. Every non-contact response is asserted to contain none of the shop's phone, e-mail or address nor the buyers' phone or e-mail. Executed with Newman on a fresh database.

exec: // Farm Management API - collection pre-request script (runs before EVERY request).
// 1) Sanctum SPA requirements of this API (verified against the backend):
//    - a stateful Origin on EVERY request (SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS), otherwise the session is ignored / register is 400;
//    - on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE the header X-XSRF-TOKEN = URL-decoded value of the XSRF-TOKEN cookie issued by GET /auth/csrf-cookie.
pm.variables.set("frontend_origin", origin);                       // also resolves the visible Origin header
// {{xsrf_token}} is refreshed by the collection Tests script after EVERY response (Laravel rotates the CSRF token on login/register/logout),
// so it is the newest value; the cookie jar is only the fallback (first request, or after the variable was cleared).
if (!xsrf) { const c = pm.cookies.get("XSRF-TOKEN"); if (c) { xsrf = decodeURIComponent(c); pm.environment.set("xsrf_token", xsrf); } }
pm.variables.set("xsrf_token", xsrf);                              // resolves the visible X-XSRF-TOKEN header
else { console.warn("No XSRF-TOKEN cookie yet: send \"Initialise CSRF cookie\" (GET /auth/csrf-cookie) first."); }
// 2) Per-request dynamic values (local variables). Lagos is UTC+1 with no daylight saving.
const H = 3600e3, D = 24 * H, now = Date.now();
const lagos = (days) => new Date(now + H + days * D).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
// Keep {{xsrf_token}} equal to the CURRENT XSRF-TOKEN cookie after EVERY response.
// Laravel rotates the CSRF token whenever the session is regenerated (login, register, logout) and re-issues the cookie on that response;
// a value remembered earlier (e.g. at "Initialise CSRF cookie") is then stale and the next write fails with 419 session_expired.
// The new value is read from this response's Set-Cookie header (does not depend on the cookie jar API).
console.log("[csrf] xsrf_token " + (fresh ? "refreshed from this response" : "unchanged") + " (fingerprint " + String(pm.environment.get("xsrf_token") || "").slice(12, 24) + ")");
